The rabbit visits the cat.

Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?

Visits(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) ::: The bald eagle visits the rabbit.
Needs(Cat, BaldEagle, True) ::: The cat needs the bald eagle.
Needs(Cat, Cow, True) ::: The cat needs the cow.
Visits(Cat, Rabbit, True) ::: The cat visits the rabbit.
Likes(Cow, BaldEagle, True) ::: The cow likes the bald eagle.
Likes(Cow, Rabbit, True) ::: The cow likes the rabbit.
Visits(Cow, BaldEagle, True) ::: The cow visits the bald eagle.
Green(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is green.
Red(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is red.
Needs(Rabbit, Cat, True) ::: The rabbit needs the cat.

Rules:
Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) && Red($x, True) >>> Visits($x, Cow, True) ::: If someone needs the bald eagle and they are red then they visit the cow.
Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Needs(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) ::: If someone needs the bald eagle then the bald eagle needs the rabbit.
Needs($x, Cat, True) >>> Likes($x, BaldEagle, True) ::: If someone needs the cat then they like the bald eagle.
Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Red($x, True) ::: If someone needs the bald eagle then they are red.
Green($x, True) >>> Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) ::: If someone is green then they need the bald eagle.
Likes($x, BaldEagle, True) && Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Visits(BaldEagle, Rabbit, True) ::: If someone likes the bald eagle and they need the bald eagle then the bald eagle visits the rabbit.
Likes(Cat, BaldEagle, True) >>> Visits(BaldEagle, Cow, True) ::: If the cat likes the bald eagle then the bald eagle visits the cow.
Visits($x, Cow, True) >>> Needs($x, Cat, True) ::: If someone visits the cow then they need the cat.
Rough(Cow, True) && Nice(Cow, True) >>> Red(Cow, True) ::: If the cow is rough and the cow is nice then the cow is red.

Query:
Visits(Rabbit, Cat, True) ::: The rabbit visits the cat.
